## Summary
Correlate save vs restore events and skip reasons to explain why ~95% of context checkpoints are never reused, with timeline correlation to the 2026-08-26 incident (parent: LP-0MTAQNB7J0094X71).

## Acceptance Criteria
- Per-factor breakdown of missed restores: context-size gating, load-aware gating, circuit-breaker cooldown, affinity/registry breaks (session-slot), slots_stale, /slots 500s, lease churn — with counts from the F1 corpus.
- Timeline correlation: snapshot writes (22:02-23:09, 2026-08-26) mapped to session activity and proxy state (available_slots, slots_stale, local_active_queries).
- Root-cause write-up with log-based evidence per factor (parent AC #1). State which factors dominate and which are secondary.

- **Root-cause write-up**: Why checkpoints are saved but not restored (affinity breaks, `slots_stale`, size gating, 500s, lease churn) with log-based evidence and timeline correlation to the 2026-08-26 incident. (covers parent AC #1)

## Minimal Implementation
- Run F1 corpus queries per factor with counts.
- Build timeline chart of snapshot writes vs proxy status line events.
- Cross-reference gating decisions (slot persistence skipped ... reason=...) with subsequent requests for the same session.
- Verify llama-server native checkpoint compatibility assumption across the measured window.

## Key Files
- /var/log/llama-proxy/llama-server.log
- /var/log/llama-proxy/proxy.log
- /home/rgardler/projects/llm/slot-cache/
- proxy/proxy/session.py (_build_slot_context, _slot_persistence_enabled, _slot_persistence_skip_when_busy)


## Dependencies
LP-0MTCMEJX2008W85X (F1 corpus).

## Deliverables
Root-cause section of evaluation report.
data.title: F2: Save/restore reuse-gap root-cause analysis

data.author: implement
data.comment: F2 implementation: analysis script scripts/slot_reuse_gap_analysis.py (reuses F1 harness parsers) + 10 tests (proxy/tests/test_slot_reuse_gap_analysis.py) + root-cause write-up docs/dev/save-restore-reuse-gap-root-cause.md. Key findings (2026-08-26): (1) mechanism conflation — proxy slot persistence restored at 89.7% (926 saves/831 restores) while llama-server NATIVE checkpoints restored at 4.83% (3191/154), which is the incident's ~95% number; native restores are same-slot same-task recovery, not session reuse. (2) the REAL gap: context-size gating excluded 1902 context_too_large requests across 38/48 sessions with ZERO persistence (top sessions 409/267/207/199/183/161 skips, 0 saves) — persistence is skipped exactly for the sessions that need reuse most. (3) secondary: slots_stale 47.4%, GET /slots 500 9.4%, 307 orphan/evicted lease releases. Validated assumptions: native checkpoint cross-restart compatibility NOT verified (0 prompt_load calls).
